lines.sentence: Ha! Out performed by me at my worst? Your quiet demeanor might be ominous, but nobody should be ALL show!

The cloaked figures sat knocked out on the side of the road, unconscious from the battle. But to Straeon, anything a killer loses after an attempt at one’s life is a paid cost. Aside from their weapons, they weren’t carrying much though, only a piece of parchment.
Well well! What do we have here?
Silence is a virtue. Let loose the Light of life.
Unnerving. Straeon quickly turned it in upon making his way finally into the new town, telling the local cavalry.
While he was left unaware, the town’s protectors would not find the bodies he swore couldn’t be missed.
